--sync-listing backs up each Play listing image it is about to replace, by design (#1099 review finding 4). The url is pinned by playImageUrlOrRefuse to https://lh3.googleusercontent.com, the host edits.images.list returned for every slot of the live record (measured 2026-10-01), or the loopback test seam; a redirect is refused (redirect: manual); the file name is fixed by the script and the response cannot choose the path, which sits under --backup-dir (default build/, gitignored). Added 2026-10-01.

--sync-listing writes the listing and contact details Play held, as a backup, before it replaces them (#1099 review finding 4). The origin is the pinned Play API origin (loopbackOr: the real origin or the loopback test seam only); the file is the fixed listing.json under --backup-dir (default build/, gitignored), so the response cannot choose the path. Added 2026-10-01.

record-deployment.mjs:397 (api(), the one GitHub read rollback.mjs shares). Since PR #1135 the rollback floor reads tooling/ops/rollback-floors.json and puts its floor commit into `compare/<floor>...<sha>`; that is a 40-hex commit SHA validated by floorsFor, not a secret, and it goes only to api.github.com (githubApiBase: the real origin or the loopback test seam). Added 2026-10-02.

worker-secrets.mjs:188 (cf()'s request options; :151 when CodeQL flagged it). What cf() reads from the vault, the Cloudflare account id and API token (URL and Authorization header) and the secret value (the PUT body), goes only to Cloudflare, to set a Worker secret: the purpose of the tool (owner lock 2026-10-01: every Worker secret comes from the pipeline). The only host is api.cloudflare.com: apiBase() refuses any CLOUDFLARE_API_BASE except a 127.0.0.1 test double, and no value is ever printed (len + sha8 only). Added 2026-10-02.

worker-secrets.mjs:190 (cf()'s PUT body; :153 when CodeQL flagged it). The vault value is the body of PUT /accounts/<id>/workers/scripts/<w>/secrets on api.cloudflare.com, which sets a Worker secret: the purpose of the tool. apiBase() admits no other host but a 127.0.0.1 test double, and no value is ever printed. Added 2026-10-02.

tooling/ops/check-edge-zone.mjs (#1147) passes the declared `zone` from tooling/edge/zone.json to readZoneRecords/zoneId, which GET it from the literal CF_API origin (https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4) with the read token: comparing the declared zone with the live one is the script's purpose. The file cannot choose the host, and validateDeclaration refuses any `zone` that is not a bare lowercase DNS name (ZONE_NAME) before a request is built; the value is URL-encoded into the query. Added 2026-10-02.

readBeatApi GETs the laptop heartbeat (beat.json on the non-branch ref refs/lead/heartbeat, resolved through /git/ref to a commit sha the module holds to 40 hex) from the GitHub contents API; the ref and file name come from tooling/autopilot/contract.json, the autopilot contract, and reading that beat is the function's purpose (O-LAPTOP-OUTAGE-READS-AS-RED). The file cannot choose the host (GITHUB_API_URL or the literal api.github.com); the module refuses at load a ref or file that is not a plain git name, readBeatApi refuses a repo that is not owner/name before a request is built, and the ref is held to refs/<ns>/<name> and refused when it is a branch or a tag. Added 2026-10-02 (club-rt-autopilot).

restClient sends JSON bodies to the GitHub REST API: label names from tooling/autopilot/contract.json (review-gate.yml) and, for post-verdict.mjs, the review verdict file's text, whose whole purpose is to be posted as a COMMENT review (O-REVIEWS-DEPEND-ON-THE-LAPTOP). The file cannot choose the host; restClient refuses a repo that is not owner/name and any path outside the shape it builds, and post-verdict refuses a verdict file without the VERDICT line, over 65,000 characters, or carrying a secret-shaped string, before anything is posted. Added 2026-10-02 (club-rt-autopilot).

readBeatApi's second request reads beat.json at the commit sha the git ref API returned for refs/lead/heartbeat; the file name comes from tooling/autopilot/contract.json, and reading the laptop heartbeat is the function's purpose (O-LAPTOP-OUTAGE-READS-AS-RED). The file cannot choose the host (GITHUB_API_URL or the literal api.github.com); the module refuses at load a ref that is not refs/<ns>/<name> or a file that is not a plain git name, readBeatApi refuses a repo that is not owner/name, and the sha must be 40 hex characters (SHA_SHAPE) before the request is built. The same flow as alert 582, re-numbered when the read moved to the ref API (review of #1171, ruling 1). Added 2026-10-02 (club-rt-autopilot).

The CDP commands (carrying the served bundle URL, read from its index.html base href) go to the DevTools socket of the headless Chrome this script launched; the script refuses any DevTools URL that is not ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/ before sending.

A SELECT-only read of box_config_manifest through the Cloudflare D1 HTTP API with the Cloudflare token is intended. The host is a literal; services/platform/wrangler.jsonc supplies only the database id, and d1QueryUrl() refuses (CouldNotLook) any database_id that is not a UUID before it enters the URL (tooling/ci/test/box-config-drift.test.mjs feeds x/../../user and sees no fetch made).
